intro: Two kinds come up: sizing something ("how many X") and explaining a change ("metric Y dropped, why"). Interviewers score the structure and the assumptions, not the final number.

sizing.title: Sizing something
steps: Pick a path: top-down (start from a big population, narrow it) or bottom-up (start from one unit, multiply up).
State the population you start from, out loud, with a number.
Apply one filter at a time. Say the assumption before each: penetration, frequency, price.
Multiply through. Round hard — keep the arithmetic simple.
Sanity check against something you know. If it's 10x off a real figure, find which assumption is wrong.

example.q: How many cups of chai are sold in Mumbai per day?
work: ~5k tea stalls in Mumbai × ~2k cups = 10M. Close enough.

diagnosis.title: A metric dropped — explain it
diagnosis.note: The classic: "You're the PM at Netflix. Watch time drops 5% week over week. What do you do?" Don't guess a cause. Narrow it.
steps: Confirm it's real. Is the drop bigger than normal week-to-week noise? Is the tracking still working?
Segment. Platform, region, new vs existing, free vs paid. Everywhere, or one slice?
Time it. When exactly did it start? Line that up against releases, experiments, campaigns, outages.
Split the metric. Watch time = users × sessions × minutes per session. Which factor moved?
Check the outside world. Competitor launch, a holiday, a news event, seasonality.
Form one hypothesis, test it cheaply, then decide.

questionSets.note: No product involved. Practice the population-funnel muscle.
questions: How many people in India use public transport daily?
How many school teachers are there in India?
How many litres of milk are consumed in Bengaluru per day?
How many weddings happen in India each year?
How many mobile phone screens crack in Delhi each month?

questionSets.note: Physical goods and services. Watch for replacement rate and seasonality.
questions: How many cars are sold in Pune in a year?
How many umbrellas are sold in Mumbai during monsoon?
How many pizzas does Domino's sell in India per day?
How many ACs are installed in Chennai each summer?
How many cricket bats are sold in India per year?

questionSets.note: Digital. Chain population → internet → smartphone → app → active use.
questions: How many WhatsApp messages are sent in India per day?
How many food-delivery orders does Swiggy get in a tier-2 city per day?
How much storage would Google Photos need for all of India?
How many UPI transactions happen in India per day?
How many hours of video does an average Indian Instagram user watch per week?
How many rides does Rapido complete in Hyderabad per day?

anchors.title: Numbers to memorise
anchors.note: Round, current-ish figures. Good enough for a guesstimate — state them as assumptions.
